parsed.explanation: Thin trans-specific record with a criminal sexuality regime, no SOGI protection, and no LGBT organisations or helplines, so the structural signals point toward risk. The most serious documented item is state misuse of general law: in 2019 a trans teenager was assaulted and then charged with fraud for presenting as a woman, though the prosecutor withdrew the charge without reasons. Also documented: 2018 physical attacks on cross-dressing men, with a head-of-government condemnation (a modest positive), and a 2023 report of bias violence and discrimination in daily life. The 2011 murderous threats are dated. Sections 146/148 are not shown to be enforced, so they weigh as a secondary signal. No visitor-facing screening or facilities rule is documented, but healthcare, custody and facilities practice are unknown and extrapolated as risky. Recourse is absent. Score sits in high risk.
